about.name: Felipe Silveira
about.title: Software Developer building polished web, mobile and data products
about.summary: I design and ship reliable software with React, React Native, TypeScript and Node, translating product and business needs into fast, maintainable experiences.
bullets: Strong in React, TypeScript, API integration and intentional UI design
Build internal systems, dashboards and product flows with pragmatic architecture
Hands-on with SQL, Power BI and automation to support better decisions
Comfortable moving between frontend, backend, cloud delivery and collaboration
New lead developer of the company's ERP system, delivering new modules in React + TypeScript across every business area — from requirements to production
Design and maintain Node.js / Express REST APIs that drive daily operations across multiple departments
Build process automations for Engineering, Operations, HR, and Finance — eliminating high‑volume manual workflows
Own Power BI dashboards that give management real‑time visibility into costs, KPIs, and workforce data
Customized and extended a legacy ERP system to fit evolving business requirements across multiple departments
Improved and maintained internal REST APIs, increasing reliability and reducing response errors
Diagnosed and resolved bugs across the full codebase, progressively taking ownership of increasingly complex issues

sistaq.description: Modernized an ERP interface with React + TypeScript, improving usability, navigation, and data entry workflows. Delivered clean UI patterns, better form validation, and faster tables with filtering and sorting.

cosmonaut.description: Built an e‑commerce prototype with product catalog, cart flows, and webhook-based integrations. Focused on component reuse, accessibility, and a smooth browsing experience.

kpi.title: Key Performance Indicators
kpi.description: Using Power Query for data ingestion, DAX for measures, and custom visuals for KPI tracking, I built Maintenance and Supplies modules to give Engineering, Operations, and Finance real-time visibility into cost drivers. Users slice by period, drill into personnel, overhead, and inventory, and compare actuals vs targets at a glance.

workforce.title: Workforce Cost
workforce.description: Created a dedicated Maintenance – Personnel page to drill into every element of headcount cost. Added a Deviation Analysis view where actual monthly and cumulative personnel spend are plotted against dynamic target lines for quick variance diagnosis.
